whyUs.title: Why choose us
whyUs.verifiedBody: Every published profile has passed age verification and human moderation before going live — no exceptions.
whyUs.discretionBody: Contact details are never shown publicly or kept in our logs: revealed on request only, anonymously, no account needed.
whyUs.directContactBody: You contact the provider directly, with no middleman and no commission. We're a listings publisher, not an agency.
